source_facts.yol_rule: ZilleTile_129 Yol (Derdia) is impassable: manifest impassable=true, 0 adjacency links (4 dropped). Included in Derdia theatre lists only as a visible/impassable tile: never movable, never a unit slot. Do not remove that rule.
source_facts.zille_vs_wehlen: Manifest field "region" is the authority. Zille (60) = peninsula incl. island 3 Manes Riuz (start_owner Wehlen). Wehlen (33) = continental Wehlen 68-71,73-95,119-122 + islands 72 Kreleck Islands and 96 Rotsla. Zille and continental Wehlen share NO land edge (separated by sea).
source_facts.brenas: Brenas (29) = Rizia-owned land 23, 40-67 (incl. city 23 Mave Nortus). Zille<->Brenas land border has 19 land edges.
source_facts.rotsla: ZilleTile_96 Rotsla is group Wehlen, island, sea-only links (coastal to S27, S28, S34, S35). It has no land edge, so it can never enter the Ark band.

ark_border_band.method: Zille provinces at graph distance exactly 1 from any Brenas province using only adjacency edges with type=="land" (sea, coastal and strait edges ignored; manual land links count as land only if typed land - none touch Brenas).

assumptions_and_decisions.decision: Lists define active/available theatre, not ownership or deployment.
"Wszystkie prowincje w Wehlen" = all 33 provinces of manifest group Wehlen, incl. islands 72 Kreleck Islands and 96 Rotsla.
Derdia = all 7 group-Derdia ids 123-129; 129 Yol stays included as an impassable visible tile. ArkD minus Ark = exactly these 7 in both phases.
One-province Zille band = Zille provinces with a true land edge to Brenas (11 ids). No sea/strait path is used, Rotsla 96 and Manes Riuz 3 are not in it.
Sword phase 1 land = whole Zille group (60, incl. island 3 Manes Riuz reached by straits) + Rotsla 96 + all Brenas (29).
Brenas (all 29 provinces) is ALWAYS active, in every plan and every phase (user: "Brenas jest w obu scenariuszach ... Brenas Zawsze jest dostepne").

Phase 1: 47 seas = all 57 minus S1, S2, S3, S27, S33, S34, S38, S39, S40, S53 (user quote: Wszystko minus (S1, S2, S3, S38, S39, S40, S27, S33, S34, S53)). Phase 2: all 57. Rotsla 96 keeps sea access via S28 and S35.
Ark (D) phase 2 = whole map incl. Derdia (186). Ark and Sword phase 2 = whole map without Derdia (179), per user notation "(+D)" only on Ark (D).
Edges from an active to a disabled province are listed per stage; the implementer should block movement/attack across them (or treat disabled tiles as non-existent).
Phase-2 militia spawning in Wehlen every 2 turns is NOT implemented here (deferred; user handles it).
